'''ar2dee2 Han, ol' buddy, your my favorite decoration!''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[ar2dee2]]
* '''Published:''' 5 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / Cloud City Occupation|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif|label=Carbon Chamber Testing}}
* '''Strategy:''' Carbon Chamber Testing
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 CCT ar2dee2 DS 2001 GPN.txt |Download]]

The best CCT out there!

The published list has 62 cards.
